long_biography.plain_text:
Columbia Shipmanagement began in Limassol in 1978 as Heinrich Schoeller's specialist ship-management company. It grew into an international maritime-services platform, establishing him as a central figure in Cyprus's shipping sector. Cyprus formally recognised that contribution with its Maritime Award.

Schoeller had spent years at sea before taking shore-based technical and managing-director posts in Germany and Cyprus. That experience shaped a company organised around technical management, crewing and long-term client service. He remains founder and chairman, while a chief executive and other professional managers lead daily operations across the global group.
